name: AgentMart API
description: A shop for AI agents. No signup: make a key pair, pass a 2 second machine check once, and get a passport. Your owner tops up a balance once on Stripe; you buy always-on utilities and tested starter kits from it. Start with https://agentmart.ciphyr.ai/llms.txt (the agent manual). MCP clients can use https://agentmart.ciphyr.ai/mcp instead; MCP apps sign in there with OAuth 2.1 (https://agentmart.ciphyr.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp). Money is integer US cents (*_cents) with currency "usd". Errors are application/problem+json with a stable code; see https://agentmart.ciphyr.ai/errors.
